data.title: bn-1uspo: research/35 ForgedSigningLineage red-team class and signing-wire injection tests

data.body: [HIGH] This counted isolation-escape case never carries its hostile payload. The shared runner parses the prose as a ContinuationHandle, then substitutes a fixed nonexistent handle when parsing fails (crates/continuumd/tests/g2_injection_corpus_evidence.rs:681-687). No stored continuation contains the rotation cycle or seed-leak text. The case still increments the 48-case and eleven-by-three assertions, so the new security class can pass with a vacuous isolation leg. Failure modes: false green corpus evidence and a missed second-order continuation attack. Edge cases: malformed handles, valid attacker-chosen handles, absent continuations, and hostile stored continuations all need distinct coverage. Rollback: revert this case and its floor increase, or keep autonomous promotion locked until a real carrier exists. Monitoring: assert that hostile and benign resolved continuation content differs before dispatch, and retain typed denial and audit counters. Validation: provision a real hostile continuation, drive task.resume at its required protocol, and add a negative control that makes resume trust the stored instruction and must fail.

[MEDIUM] The hostile-versus-benign test claims byte-identical answers but compares only error_code. requests(bytes) ignores bytes for mint, rotate, and revoke (lines 4004-4013), while signing.verify can return different SignatureOutcome, signer, or successor values with error_code None. Thus the test can stay green when hostile content changes the only read response that consumes it. Compare the full typed verify payload, and explicitly account for operations whose request shape has no payload carrier.

data.reason: HIGH: the new ForgedSigningLineage isolation case is counted but never carries or resolves its hostile continuation payload; MEDIUM: the signing-wire differential compares only error codes and uses identical requests for payload-free operations.

data.body: [RESOLVED] Target 344f37b5 moves this case to observe.ingest. The shared planter now places the hostile bytes in ObserveIngestRequest.instrumentation_profile at crates/continuumd/tests/g2_injection_corpus_evidence.rs:661-664. The 28 carrying and 9 inert census at gate_g2_07_acceptance.rs:1570-1583 includes this real carrier. The fixed-handle task.resume fallback no longer applies to this new case.

data.reason: Target 344f37b5 supplies a real payload carrier through observe.ingest.

data.body: [RESOLVED] Target 344f37b5 separates payload-free mint, rotate, and revoke checks at crates/continuumd/tests/daemon_signing.rs:4001-4043. The three real carriers are isolated at lines 4045-4060. signing.verify now compares the complete typed response and rejects Verified at lines 4101-4122.

data.reason: Target 344f37b5 compares the full verify response and excludes payload-free requests from the differential.

data.body: [RISK:HIGH REVIEW] Failure modes: a vacuous carrier or partial-response comparison can produce false security evidence. Edge cases: payload-free operations, open verify responses, pre-3.8 codec refusal, malformed handles, and hostile stored content. Rollback: revert this range and retain the prior 45-case corpus with human-approved promotion only. Monitoring: keep the exact taxonomy, carrier census, full typed-response comparison, and five explicit promotion-gate RED clauses. Validation: reviewed the complete daa0d34d..344f37b5 range and traced payloads through wire planting, admission, handlers, and typed responses. No tests were rerun because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata.

data.reason: Risk-high questions answered; no unresolved range finding remains.

LGTM for daa0d34d..344f37b5. Both prior findings are repaired: the isolation case now has a real observe.ingest carrier, and signing.verify compares its full typed response. Static review only. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.
